name: trade-auditor
track: 02 - The Agent That Can Explain Why
challenge_question: Why did this trade pass or fail my system?

sponsor_tech.zetaris: Data layer. All journal lookups (trades + notes, joined) go through Zetaris as the data harness; the agent never reads journal files directly. Local CSV reader with the identical contract is the fallback until the instance is provisioned (see src/auditor/data_pipe.py).
sponsor_tech.meterless: Engine patterns, implemented in Python from Meterless's published specs (see docs/meterless.md). Four engines, no SDK: World Model = the day's declared frame + running state; H-MEM = the journal row + day history every claim must cite, verified by the Evaluator (provenance); Markovian = one bounded audit unit per trade; Scout Intent = the one question plus guardrails, emitted by the Planner as the contract the Executor follows and the Evaluator checks. Planner / Executor / Evaluator are roles in sequence, not a Meterless engine.
sponsor_tech.cursor: Build layer. Project built in Cursor; git history is the build log.
